The *Adhimuttattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 38) is a verse biographical poem preserved in the *Therāpadāna* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the past deeds and spiritual attainment of the elder Adhimutta. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the work across five languages [SuttaCentral].
No cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan are recorded for this text [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis via DharmaNexus indicates substantial Pali-internal text reuse. Portions of the poem are extensively cited or shared with the commentary on the *Theragāthā* (*Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā*, both parts one and two) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, repetitive or formulaic verses from segments 4.2–6.1 are shared with other poems within the *Therāpadāna*, specifically the *Ekāsanadāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 254) and the *Annasaṁsāvakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 328) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
